title: Bipartite DNA binding domain of transcription factor BCL11B binds clustered short DNA sequence motifs
authors: Jisun Lee; Jujun Zhou; John R. Horton; Meigen Yu; Munachi Daniella Muoghalu; Faizan Ahmed Khan; Xiaotian Zhang; Yun Huang; Robert M. Blumenthal; Xing Zhang; Xiaodong Cheng
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构域解析与序列分析揭示BCL11B双锌指阵列识别簇状DNA基序的分子机制，聚焦TF-DNA结合特异性与柔性互作模式，虽以实验为主但为TF-DNA界面建模提供关键结构特征与突变数据，高度契合本课题。
abstract: B - c ell l eukemia/lymphoma 11B (BCL11B), despite its name, is a key regulator of T-cell development, specification, and T-cell malignancies. BCL11B contains a bipartite DNA binding domain composed of two C2H2 zinc finger arrays: low-affinity ZF2-3 and high affinity ZF4-6. These arrays function as homotypic modules that recognize similar six-nucleotide motifs, TG( n )CC( c/t/a ), as seven of the eight DNA base-contacting residues are conserved between them. The most conserved interactions involve GG dinucleotides, contacted by arginine and lysine residues at key base-interacting positions in ZF3 and ZF5. The two ZF arrays are connected by a long ∼300-residue linker that provides flexibility in how the arrays engage DNA, allowing ZF2-3 and ZF4-6 binding to the same or opposite strands with variable orientation, spacing and positioning along the DNA. This extended linker is enriched in serine/threonine, acidic residues (aspartate/glutamate), and structural residues (glycine/proline), providing additional layers of transcriptional regulation possibly through post-translational modification, electrostatic modulation, and/or condensate formation. We also examined six missense mutations in base-interacting residues, that are associated with neurodevelopmental disorders. Substitutions replacing bulky, positively charged arginine or lysine with smaller or hydrophobic residues likely reduce DNA-binding affinity and/or specificity, whereas substitutions between asparagine and lysine may alter base recognition preferences.
abstract_zh: B细胞白血病/淋巴瘤11B（BCL11B），尽管其名称如此，却是T细胞发育、特化及T细胞恶性肿瘤的关键调控因子。BCL11B包含一个由两个C2H2锌指阵列组成的双部分DNA结合域：低亲和力ZF2-3和高亲和力ZF4-6。这些阵列作为同型模块发挥作用，识别相似的六个核苷酸基序，TG(n)CC(c/t/a)，因为八个与DNA碱基接触的残基中有七个在它们之间是保守的。最保守的相互作用涉及GG二核苷酸，由ZF3和ZF5中关键碱基相互作用位置的精氨酸和赖氨酸残基接触。两个ZF阵列由一个约300残基的长连接子连接，该连接子提供了阵列与DNA结合时的灵活性，允许ZF2-3和ZF4-6以可变的取向、间距和沿DNA的位置结合到相同或相反的链上。这个延伸的连接子富含丝氨酸/苏氨酸、酸性残基（天冬氨酸/谷氨酸）和结构残基（甘氨酸/脯氨酸），可能通过翻译后修饰、静电调节和/或凝聚体形成提供额外的转录调控层次。我们还检查了与神经发育障碍相关的六个碱基相互作用残基的错义突变。将体积大、带正电荷的精氨酸或赖氨酸替换为较小或疏水性残基的替代可能降低DNA结合亲和力和/或特异性，而天冬酰胺和赖氨酸之间的替换可能改变碱基识别偏好。
